explication: Tokscale combines a local Rust CLI that reads AI-agent usage, analyzes token and cost data, and presents it in a terminal UI with a web service for sharing submissions. The main workflow runs from local agent data through provider-specific session parsing and aggregation to reports or an optional leaderboard submission; the web application then supports public profiles, rankings, and groups. Pricing lookup and live provider-usage queries are additional capabilities. Some frontend and CLI subsystems are represented by their exact directories because their implementation was not sampled; those links rely on README documentation where noted.
